# University of Maryland, Baltimore

> > University of Maryland, Baltimore's Health Sciences & Human Services Library (HSHSL) provides comprehensive resources and services supporting health sciences education, research, and innovation.

The HSHSL serves the University of Maryland, Baltimore community with specialized library services, including the Innovation Space makerspace featuring 3D printing capabilities. The library supports students, faculty, and researchers across health sciences and human services disciplines with guides, technology resources, and hands-on learning opportunities.

## Key Topics

- University of Maryland Health Sciences & Human Services Library (HSHSL)
- Innovation Space
- 3D printing and additive manufacturing
- PLA (polylactic acid) filament
- ABS (acrylonitrile butadiene styrene) filament
- PETG (polyethylene terephthalate) filament
- PVA (polyvinyl alcohol) support material
- Library makerspace services
- Filament selection and material properties
- Health sciences research support
- University of Maryland, Baltimore

- [Filament to Choose - 3D Printing at the Innovation Space](https://guides.hshsl.umaryland.edu/c.php?g=163717&p=4438503): Guide to selecting 3D printing filaments (PLA, ABS, PETG) at HSHSL
